name: Async suspended cleanup preservation requires exception context support

input.source_text: class R { public fun close() -> Object { raise :close_failed } } module M { public async fun inner(g) -> Object { using(R.new()) { let v = await g; raise :body_failed } } } let g = Gate.new(); let t = M.inner(g); let posted = Gate.complete(g, 7); try { Host.run(t) } catch v, c { [v, c.suppressed.length] }

applicability.reason: Supported. C037 keeps cleanup LIFO across async suspension and requires a cleanup failure after resumption to use the same primary-plus-suppressed ordering as synchronous cleanup, without losing it because the Task suspended. The earlier reason reported a nil primary and no suppressed context; that was a measurement error, calling `Iris.using` where C032 makes `using` an ordinary bare-call helper, so the probe never reached the cleanup path at all. Measured with the right spelling and driven through `Host.run`, a body failure after resumption reports body_failed as PRIMARY with the close failure suppressed beside it, exactly as the synchronous case does, and nested resources still close inner-before-outer across the suspension.
